# Tables

```{r table1, echo = FALSE}
t1w <- read.csv("../analysis/results/table1_bias.csv")
t1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("0.2", "0.5", "0.8"), function(d) {
  data.frame(
    rho       = t1w$rho_true,
    delta     = as.numeric(d),
    bias_obs  = t1w[[paste0("bias_obs_d", d)]],
    bias_corr = t1w[[paste0("bias_corr_d", d)]],
    rmse_obs  = t1w[[paste0("rmse_obs_d", d)]],
    rmse_corr = t1w[[paste0("rmse_corr_d", d)]]
  )
}))
t1 <- t1[order(t1$rho, t1$delta), ]
knitr::kable(
  t1, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
  col.names = c("$\\rho_{xx}$", "$\\delta$",
                "Bias (uncorr.)", "Bias (corr.)",
                "RMSE (uncorr.)", "RMSE (corr.)"),
  caption = paste(
    "Table 1. Bias and RMSE of the uncorrected and corrected Cohen's d,",
    "averaged over sample size (normal distribution, known reliability).")
)
```

```{r table2, echo = FALSE}
t2 <- read.csv("../analysis/results/table3_meta.csv")
knitr::kable(
  t2, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
  col.names = c("k", "$\\delta_{\\mu}$", "Reliability pattern",
                "Bias (uncorr.)", "Bias (corr.)",
                "RMSE (uncorr.)", "RMSE (corr.)",
                "Coverage (uncorr.)", "Coverage (corr.)"),
  caption = paste(
    "Table 2. Bias, RMSE, and 95% CI coverage of the pooled",
    "random-effects estimate under homogeneous and heterogeneous",
    "between-study reliability.")
)
```

```{r table3, echo = FALSE}
t3 <- read.csv("../analysis/results/simulation_bootstrap.csv")
t3 <- t3[, c("dist", "n", "rho", "delta",
             "coverage_bca", "coverage_hs", "coverage_bo",
             "width_bca", "width_hs", "width_bo")]
knitr::kable(
  t3, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
  col.names = c("Distribution", "$n$", "$\\rho_{xx}$", "$\\delta$",
                "Cov. BCa", "Cov. HS", "Cov. Bonett",
                "Width BCa", "Width HS", "Width Bonett"),
  caption = paste(
    "Table 3. Coverage and mean width of the BCa bootstrap,",
    "Hunter-Schmidt (HS), and Bonett intervals in the bootstrap",
    "sub-study (1,000 replications per cell, 999 resamples each,",
    "known reliability).")
)
```

```{r table4, echo = FALSE}
t4 <- read.csv("../analysis/results/substudy_rxxse.csv")
knitr::kable(
  t4[, c("k_items", "n", "rho", "coverage_naive", "coverage_se",
         "mean_se_hat", "emp_sd_alpha")],
  row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
  col.names = c("$k$ items", "$n$", "$\\rho_{xx}$",
                "Coverage (naive)", "Coverage (`rxx_se`)",
                "Mean $\\widehat{SE}(\\hat{\\alpha})$",
                "Empirical $SD(\\hat{\\alpha})$"),
  caption = paste(
    "Table 4. Coverage of the Hunter-Schmidt interval evaluated at",
    "the estimated alpha, without (naive) and with the rxx_se",
    "delta-method term (2,000 replications per cell; bootstrap SE of",
    "alpha with B = 200).")
)
```

```{r table5, echo = FALSE}
t5 <- read.csv("../analysis/results/substudy_design.csv")
t5$design <- ifelse(
  t5$block == "B1_unbalanced", "Unbalanced 1:3",
  ifelse(t5$block == "B2_heteroscedastic", "Variance ratio 2:1",
         ifelse(t5$pairing == "positive",
                "Combined (pos. pair.)", "Combined (neg. pair.)")))
t5_show <- t5[t5$block != "B3_combined" | TRUE, ]
knitr::kable(
  t5_show[, c("design", "n1", "rho", "coverage_hs", "coverage_bo",
              "width_hs", "width_bo")],
  row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
  col.names = c("Design", "$n_1$", "$\\rho_{xx}$",
                "Cov. HS", "Cov. Bonett", "Width HS", "Width Bonett"),
  caption = paste(
    "Table 5. Coverage and mean width of the Hunter-Schmidt (HS) and",
    "Bonett intervals under unbalanced group sizes (equal variances;",
    "B1), heteroscedastic true scores with balanced groups (B2), and",
    "the combined Behrens-Fisher condition with positive or negative",
    "pairing of variance and group size (B3); 5,000 replications per",
    "cell. n_1 is the smaller group in all B1/B3 conditions.")
)
```

```{r table6, echo = FALSE}
t6 <- read.csv("../analysis/results/substudy_correlation.csv")
knitr::kable(
  t6[, c("rho_xy", "rel", "n", "bias_obs", "bias_corr",
         "rmse_obs", "rmse_corr", "coverage_fisher")],
  row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
  col.names = c("$\\rho_{xy}$", "$\\rho_{xx} = \\rho_{yy}$", "$n$",
                "Bias (obs.)", "Bias (corr.)",
                "RMSE (obs.)", "RMSE (corr.)", "Cov. (CI)"),
  caption = paste(
    "Table 6. Bias, RMSE, and 95% CI coverage of the observed and",
    "two-sided-corrected correlation when both variables are fallible;",
    "5,000 replications per cell. Coverage (CI) is for the Fisher-z",
    "interval implemented in mes_r().")
)
```
